why.label: Why is it this number?
why.title: Why is it {quantity} {unit}?
why.formula: Receipts + returns − issues − scrap ± adjustments ± counts ± transfers.
why.gap: Does not add up by {gap} {unit}: this is a fault, and it is reported.
why.key: Why is this number (the focused row's quantity)
why.basisPosting: By the day each move counts on in the books.
why.basisEntry: By the day each move happened.

bridge.label: Balance bridge: the start, each reason, the end
bridge.endOn: On hand at the end of {day}
bridge.mismatch: The steps add up to {total}; the stock says otherwise ({gap}): a fault, reported.

transit.link: Goods on the way to another site: open the transfers in transit

low.noneBody: Position = on hand + on order − reserved, against the minimum each material's planning sets.
low.alertsOff: Low-stock alerts are switched off in the warehouse rules: nobody is told when a material drops below its minimum.

move.toHint: A place of the same site. A blocked place takes nothing in.
move.whole: Each row moves whole; leather moves hide by hide.
move.noteHint: Why it moves (optional): the ledger keeps it.

held.sites: Move one site at a time: a move between sites is a transfer (Warehouse › Transfers).
held.fromBlocked: {code} is blocked: nothing moves in or out of it.
held.transit: {code} is a transit place: only its transfer moves those goods.
held.pick: Pick the place it goes to.
held.toBlocked: {code} is blocked: it takes nothing in.
held.note: The note is at most 500 characters.
held.pastDate: Stock as of a past date cannot be changed.
held.noRight: Your role may not move stock.
held.pickRows: Select the rows to move first.

problem.blocked: The place is blocked (a count, damage or a clean-up): nothing moves in or out.
problem.kind: That place does not hold this kind of material.
problem.notEnough: That stock is not there any more: read the figures again.
problem.changed: Someone changed it meanwhile. Check and try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not move stock.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Try again when it is back.
problem.invalid: Something in it was not accepted.
problem.write: It was not moved. Try again.

adj.approvalHeld: Needs approval above the value the warehouse rules set
adj.approvers: Who approves: {names}. Up to that value it posts at once; above it, it waits for their yes.
adj.approversUnknown: Above that value it waits for a yes (Admin › Approvals, automation & AI › Approval rules).

posting.label: Posting date
posting.hint: The day it counts on in the books. Empty: today.
posting.checkFailed: The day could not be checked. Try again.
posting.closed: That month is closed in the books: nothing goes into it.
posting.closedBody: From {from} to {to}. Finance reopens a month.
posting.tooFar: Further back than the warehouse rules allow: the earliest is {earliest}.
posting.notAllowed: That day may not be used.
posting.lockReason: Say why it goes into a closed month.
posting.lockReasonLabel: Why it goes into a closed month
posting.lockReasonHint: The month from {from} to {to} is closed for most changes: the reason is kept with the move.
posting.countsOnHint: Dated apart from the day it happened.

waiting.buttonFailed: The adjustments waiting for approval could not be read
waiting.title: Waiting for approval
waiting.what: {material} at {place}: {from} → {to} {unit} once approved. Nothing is posted until then.
waiting.note: Adjustments worth more than the warehouse rules' value wait here; the approver decides in Home › Approvals.

kind.atTop: at the top of the tree
kind.transferOnly: only a transfer moves its goods

held.noManage: Your role may not change places.
held.archived: An archived place is not blocked.
held.notBlockable: A place outside the site or in transit is not blocked: its moves are its orders' own.
held.countBlock: Count {number} is running here: the count unblocks it when its counting ends.

block.title: Block {code}
block.effect: While it is blocked nothing moves in or out of it (a count's own moves go through).
block.untilHint: The last day it holds. Empty: until it is unblocked.

held.note: Say why in words (the reason is Other).
held.long: The note is at most 500 characters.
held.past: The last day is not before today.

unblock.title: Unblock {code}?
unblock.effect: Moves in and out of it go through again.

problem.changed: Someone changed this place meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.notNow: This place cannot be blocked or unblocked in its present state.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
problem.gone: It no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Try again when it is back.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.

new.atTop: A customer's place or a transit place sits at the top of the site's tree: pick no parent.
new.partyNoRight: Naming the customer or workshop needs access to customers and suppliers.
new.noCustomers: There is no active customer or brand to name.
new.noWorkshops: There is no active workshop to name.

record.noDefaults: No command takes it by default.
record.kindFixed: This kind stays what it is: its party or its transfers depend on it.

label.noneBody: Only places on the floor carry a bin label: a scan of it confirms a put-away, a move or a count.
label.invalid: This code cannot be printed as a barcode: {code}
label.suggestedNote: It has no code yet: printing gives it {code}.
label.ownNote: A scan of this label names this place.
label.codeHint: Letters, digits and . _ : / - without spaces; unique in the company.
label.oldCode: Labels already printed with the old code will no longer scan: print new ones.
label.savedPrinted_one: The code is saved. {count} label printed with the old code no longer scans: print a new one.
label.savedPrinted_other: The code is saved. {count} labels printed with the old code no longer scan: print new ones.
label.failedHint: Not printed: try again from Print label.

code.shape: Letters, digits and . _ : / - only, without spaces (at most 64).
code.taken: Another place already carries this code.

refused.archived: An archived place carries no label.
refused.kind: A place outside the site or in transit carries no label.

print.printerHint: A label printer of this site.
print.pdfHint: A PDF in a new tab: print it on any printer (one label per page).
print.noPrinters: No label printer at this site
print.needCode_one: {count} place has no label code yet: it gets its suggested code first.
print.needCode_other: {count} places have no label code yet: they get their suggested codes first.
print.doneBody: Each place's Labels tab shows where its job stands.
print.pdfLeftOutBody: The PDF holds the others. They changed since this page read them (archived, or now of a kind that carries no label): the places are read again when you close this.
print.noRightPdf: Your role prints labels as a PDF only (a label printer needs the print permission).

held.none: None of these places carries a label.
held.noRight: Your role may not send labels to a printer: pick the PDF.
held.needCode_one: {count} place has no label code yet and your role may not give it one: pick places with a code, or the PDF.
held.needCode_other: {count} places have no label code yet and your role may not give them one: pick places with a code, or the PDF.
held.printer: Pick a label printer, or the PDF.
held.select: Select the places to print first.
